name: Recursive Teaching Dimension of Quadratic-Residue Tournament Classes
details: For all sufficiently large primes $p\equiv3\pmod4$; here $|\mathcal Q_p|=p$.
proof: Theorem 15 of Simon proves that every quadratic-residue tournament $G_p$ has minimum teaching dimension at least $\lfloor\tfrac12\log_2p-\log_2\log_2p\rfloor$. Recursive teaching dimension is at least the minimum teaching dimension of its initial class, giving the same lower bound.
